question: Which team did the United States defeat to win the gold medal at the 2025 International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) World Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

• The United States defeated **Switzerland** to win the gold medal at the 2025 International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) World Championship.
 
• The USA team displayed exceptional performance throughout the tournament, showcasing their dominance in ice hockey.
 
• Switzerland reached the finals after defeating high-ranking teams, marking a significant achievement in their history at the IIHF World Championship.
 
• The victory brought the USA its latest gold medal in the IIHF World Championship, adding to their impressive record in international ice hockey.

• Founded in 1908, the IIHF is the governing body for international ice hockey competitions and development.
 
• The IIHF World Championship is one of the most prestigious tournaments in ice hockey, held annually.
 
 
 
• **Switzerland's Ice Hockey History:**
 
 
• Switzerland has been a consistent competitor in the IIHF World Championship, often reaching the playoffs.
 
• Their appearance in the finals of the 2025 championship was a highlight moment for Swiss ice hockey.
 
 
 
• **USA Ice Hockey Team:**
 
 
• The USA has a strong tradition in ice hockey and is considered one of the top teams globally.
 
• It has won several gold medals in international competitions, including the Olympics and World Championships.
 
 
 
• **IIHF World Championship Format:**
 
 
• The tournament features top national teams competing in a round-robin format followed by playoffs.
 
• The championship serves as a platform for showcasing the highest level of ice hockey talent globally.
